violations.how_to_fix:
It may be possible to resolve this violation as follows:

1. Try to exclude the scope of the package if it is not part of the released artifacts:
   - Check the _Paths_ section for 'PyPI::pytest-timeout:2.3.1' in the Web App scan report for the scopes where the package was found.
   - If a scope is only for packages used for building or testing your code,
     exclude it by adding a [scope exclude](https://oss-review-toolkit.org/ort/docs/configuration/ort-yml#excluding-scopes) to your [.ort.yml file](https://oss-review-toolkit.org/ort/docs/configuration/ort-yml).

2. Otherwise, add a curation for the package if its declared license includes a license choice:
   - Clone [ort-config repository](https://github.com/oss-review-toolkit/ort-config) using Git.
   - Open or create using a text editor `curations/PyPI/_/pytest-timeout.yml`.
   - Find the licenses applicable to [pytest-timeout.git repository](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-timeout.git) which are included in your release artifacts.
     (A license does not apply if the scan results show it to be in a particular file, but that file is absent in [pytest-timeout.git repository](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-timeout.git)).
   - For each license that is not compiled in your release artifacts, create an entry for 'PyPI::pytest-timeout:2.3.1' in `curations/PyPI/_/pytest-timeout.yml`, setting `concluded_license`
     to show the appropriate [SPDX license expression](https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/appendix-IV-SPDX-license-expressions/).
     Use the following template, changing the text in square brackets (`[...]`) as appropriate.

   ```

   - id: "PyPI::pytest-timeout:2.3.1"
     curations:
       comment: "[The artifact declares as licensed under 'LicenseRef-scancode-free-unknown AND MIT', see \
         https://url-to-repository/tag-or-revision-for-version-2.3.1/LICENSE and \
         https://url-to-repository/tag-or-revision-for-version-2.3.1/package-metadata-file \.
         Additionally the scanner detects ...]"
       # FIXME: The real concluded license expression, taking into account both declared and detected licenses, is
       # concluded_license: "[Applicable licenses for pytest-timeout.git repository as a SPDX license expression.]"
       # However, as we do not have a mechanism to record a license choice yet (see OSS-1163), misuse the concluded
       # license to perform the choice until we have a proper mechanism implemented:
       concluded_license: "[Chosen licenses for pytest-timeout.git repository as a SPDX license expression.]"

   ```

   - Submit the above change to the [ort-config repository](https://github.com/oss-review-toolkit/ort-config) (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oss-review-toolkit/ort-config/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance) with a commit message as shown below.
     Note that reviewers are set automatically.

   ```

   feat(curations): Conclude license for `PyPI::pytest-timeout:2.3.1`

   Relates-to: [Insert related issue number]

   ```

   - Once your [concluded license curation](https://oss-review-toolkit.org/ort/docs/configuration/ort-yml#curations) is merged, re-scan to see if the violation has been resolved.
